description.value: Sushi Time Express is a fast-casual sushi counter in Victoria's St. Andrew's Square, serving an extensive menu of rolls, rice bowls, bento boxes, nigiri and sashimi, noodles, and breakfast items alongside healthy smoothies. The Express concept centers on fresh ingredients prepared quickly at counter service, making it a practical downtown stop for cyclists passing through the Yates Street corridor. Bento boxes and a broad roll menu — including several vegetarian and potentially vegan options — give touring cyclists flexible, portable meal choices.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sushi-time-express.com confirms this is a fast-food sushi counter at #120-735 Yates Street, St. Andrew's Square, Victoria BC V8W 1L6, with phone 778-432-3663 and a fully active menu — confirming the business is real and open. The fast_food OSM tag and website language ('minimize your wait time', counter-style menu) confirm takeout service; the menu lists bento boxes as a dedicated category (portable packaged meals) and multiple clearly vegetarian items (avocado roll, yam roll, vegetable roll, salad wrap with rice paper). No bike-specific amenities appear anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
